measurementBasis: Actual receipts, authenticated indexed frame manifests, recorded RPC elapsedMs, UTC endpoints and ffprobe. No inferred gas subdivision or EVM-only CPU time.

statistics.parSource: Original g_game.c Episode One par table only; E1M8 bypasses Intermission and does not publish this value

video.notes: Gameplay targets hidden by a D_Display wipe are accounted in wipe frames. Complete status-bar coverage is overlapping, not added to the mutually exclusive total. The legacy consumer menuFrames counter contains TITLEPIC/demo-screen frames; no M_Drawer menu is included. MP4 encoding is lossy.

evm.optionalSeparateGasReason: Gameplay advance includes P_Ticker and ST/HU ticker/observation; capture includes world rendering and ST/HU/palette/frame publication. Their internal costs cannot be isolated from receipts.

transportFailuresAndRetries.automaticTransactionResubmissionBasis: Source audit: recorder send()/rpc() submits once; receipt polling does not resubmit transactions. Manual checkpoint resume counts are separately recorded.
transportFailuresAndRetries.scope: Final receipt failures are counted separately. Log observations include native gate failures, requested recovery stops and verification-port refusal; these are not failed EVM gameplay transactions.
transportFailuresAndRetries.startupConnectionProbeRetryReason: Startup readiness probes can retry before Anvil accepts connections; their individual failed probes were not logged. No transaction is resubmitted.

evm.transportFailureNote: Preserved attempt logs list observed errors. Calls that fail before obtaining a receipt have no measured gas. Resume sessions are recorded below.

execution.activeWallClockReason: Measured sum of exact recorded active sessions and exact inherited parent session where applicable; recovery downtime excluded.
execution.throughputScope: Local JSON-RPC/mining transaction intervals include transport and receipt polling. EVM-only CPU execution time is unavailable.

independentGameplayStateVerification.comparison: Every startup/advance Observation decoded independently from authenticated successful receipts and compared byte-for-byte with preserved native XOR-delta tape.

nativeReferenceProfile.profile: LP64 initialized64MiB zone; all ST/HU/WI borrowed immutable UI resources including ST_lib; temporary per-gameplay render; original source gameplay/WI/finale/melt
nativeReferenceProfile.reason: Legacy native adapter missed ST_lib STTMINUS borrowing. Only native cache interception changed; EVM frame/source/provenance unchanged.

fidelity.virtualScope: Zone address provenance4 and authenticated WAD-owner address provenance5 remain experimental even if pixel values agree. Wipe-origin propagation is separately verified; direct draw sample counts are not universal native equality.

RPCSettings.overallReceiptPollingDeadlineReason: Each receipt RPC has the per-request timeout; the polling loop has no separate aggregate deadline.

environment.engineCommitSHAReason: Frozen feature HEAD at recorder start; generated observation clone has separate exact source hashes.
